name: Darkweave Queen
description: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.description: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Den Mother
abilities.description: Once per scene, spend 2 Fear to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

abilities.name: Quicker Than She Looks
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

abilities.name: Darkfang Envenomation
abilities.description: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.
